# IDD (Issue-Driven Development) — Compatibility Redirect

This file is retained temporarily for callers that still reference the
pre-v0.11.0 overview path. The canonical runtime definitions and Project
commands table are in
`.github/instructions/idd-overview-core.instructions.md`.

On IDD startup, load
`.github/instructions/idd-overview-core.instructions.md` for the shared
definitions and phase routing table.

For detailed reference content, load
`.github/instructions/idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md`.

The compatibility path can be removed after the dependent documentation
and standard-instruction resyncs migrate their remaining references.
